test_title: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 24 Jun, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Which of the following letter-clusters should replace IP and % so that the pattern and relationship followed between the letter-cluster pair on the left side of : is the same as that on the right side of ::?

# : YFI :: LSV : %
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c28817482dab245ca34a9ed2c7d15bec309f9c5ed7d11cb8daa13bef502bdd09.png] 

Given:

# : YFI :: LSV : %

Option 1) # = VBE, % = PWZ

For # (VBE) to YFI

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dda26f6b9b54a6cd6172c11fca7113c7259096e606b3e13ffb0fa0f163fe3406.png] 

For LSV to % (PWZ)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/249fc4aaba8c2418dad6c3c7d258d8cee17460c2976fc73969d588ea7e9fae75.png] 

Option 2) # = ZBE, % = BWZ

For # (ZBE) to YFI

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/06f3f6c1934ea659e60dbd5a498a7b66e542f0e4c538762794e07cf9de3e1e85.png] 

For LSV to % (BWZ)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1d2b14fac7080913851d4eca90d6ddb1a492035a707b107236d65a3ce46aa7b3.png] 

Option 3) # = UBE, % = PWQ

For # (UBE) to YFI

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ee856c83fe9ec09a2d1f11adfaedeb45516874e2e74e1f662452896aeceafe36.png] 

For LSV to % (PWQ)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/523142530057fa449db559aac737877e4df55298c4f0955556e3dd0d18b2a7d8.png] 

**Option 4) # = UBE, % = PWZ**

**For # (UBE) to YFI**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ddcdaa3ab537d346ab671a87deedbfa5079d24a8e062cc82458454ecc0c23ea4.png] 

 

**For LSV to % (PWZ)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e8e8245d435f2caa3964fd2b2bea87ef4e28ae468ae69e4044870f7b3fac4da5.png] 

Since the patterns for both pairs match, Option 4 is the correct answer.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".
